role: The player movement packet, sent every client tick by EntityClientPlayerMP.sendMotionUpdates as one of four subclasses: flying-only (C03), position (C04), look (C05) or position+look (C06). The server's processPlayer runs the full move-verification and anti-cheat chain on it.

members.note: struct c03 field d (the bounding-box bottom, called minY in survival.h)

members.name: field_149475_d (posY/stance)
members.note: struct c03 field f (the eye position)

members.name: field_149480_h (hasPos, set by C04/C06)
members.note: the kind enum: C03_POS and C03_POSLOOK

members.name: field_149481_i (hasLook, set by C05/C06)
members.note: the kind enum: C03_LOOK and C03_POSLOOK

members.note: the acknowledgements the S08's handlePlayerPosLook sends ride client_out.confirm_c03 (survival.h) and are reprocessed by server_player_tick

members.name: func_149469_a
members.note: the setter only NetHandlerPlayServer.processPlayer calls, for a moving packet with y = stance = -999 reaching a player the server has not mounted. That packet is EntityClientPlayerMP.sendMotionUpdates' ridingEntity != null branch, but onUpdate calls sendMotionUpdates only when !isRiding() (Entity.isRiding: ridingEntity != null), so the vanilla client never sends it: a riding client sends C05 and C0C instead (ride-pig-s1, pf-deadmount-g16)

members.name: C04PacketPlayerPosition
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: The C06 acknowledgements after an S08 correction are the confirm_c03/confirm2_c03 slots in survival.h's client_out, reprocessed at the start of player.c:server_player_tick.
